items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: I played in the church, I played the trumpet, he played the drum... So, I played there with him.

ctx.x: Did he play in the church? Somebody told me he played in the church. Yeah, he played in the church.

Yeah, I meet him, look, every time I meet him, he's working on the ferry boat, you see. And every time I cross on the ferry boat, he says, sir, sir kid, when you coming up? I said, well, first chance I get, I said, I'm coming up. So once, two Sundays I went. I played in the church, I played the trumpet, he played the drum. Later played the piano. And a fellow played the guitar, electric guitar. He played nice, nice, nice guitar too. And I mean, he had really nice church, but I enjoyed it, you know? So, I played…
I remember you told me once about how they-
